exampleEn: Everyone seems to be jumping on the bandwagon of that new fitness trend.
exampleKo: 모든 사람이 그 새로운 헬스 트렌드에 편승하고 있는 것 같아.
gameExamples: Many people are starting to jump on the bandwagon of organic food consumption.
It's not enough to just jump on the bandwagon; you need to truly believe in the cause.
I decided to jump on the bandwagon and invest in renewable energy stocks after seeing their popularity rise.
